title: Cases Reported & Rate of Crimes relating to human trafficking During 2015 (State/UT – wise)
listing_title: Cases Reported & Rate of Crimes relating to human trafficking During 2015 (State/UT – wise)
pdf_title: Cases Reported & Rate of Crime Relating to Human Trafficking During 2015
notes: Rate of Cognizable Crimes = (Total Cases reported under Human Trafficking/Total Population) x 10000 i.e., Incidence of crimes relating to human trafficking per one lakh
‘#’ Human Trafficking consists of crime heads namely Section 370/370A of IPC, Importation of Girls from Foreign Country(Section 366-B IPC), Immoral Traffic (P) Act, 1956,
Procuration of Minor Girls (Section 366-A IPC), Buying of Minor Girls for Prostitution (Section 373 IPC) and Selling of Minors for Prostitution (Section 372 IPC)
